column1: Fernando Tatis Jr. leads the slate with a strong combination of recent form and consistency, hitting safely in over 70% of games and drawing a favorable matchup against Kyle Freeland at hitter-friendly Coors Field. Jake McCarthy offers similar reliability atop the order with a high hit rate and a solid park boost at home. Austin Hays and Cody Bellinger also benefit from platoon edges but trail slightly in recent performance and overall hit probability.
